notes: Per-indication config for the patientlyiq executive-summary dashboard.
Authored by hand. The page reads this to decide what to anchor and what to compare.
anchor_subtheme: drives the 'Top three quotes' widget — only fragments tagged with this subtheme are eligible. Pick the subtheme that best represents the headline story for the indication.

sentiment_axes: drives the sentiment widgets (hero + bubble). Each axis is a subset of the corpus to compute pos/neg lean over. When empty, the widgets fall back to corpus-wide overall sentiment. Axis kinds:
- 'keyword': fragments whose text matches the cluster's variants (regex match, same as KeywordText). id = cluster id in keyword_lexicon.json.
- 'theme' / 'subtheme': fragments whose segment_tags include the id.
- 'complement': everything NOT covered by any earlier axis on the list. Use this as a final 'Other' bucket.
drug_callouts and clinical_trials_blurb are reserved for analyst-authored content — leave empty until you have copy for them.
